story: Investigate a specific user U-500 by checking their activity for 30 days, searching for privilege escalation anomalies, and flagging suspicious findings. This tests targeted user investigation without starting from audit logs.

args.description: Self-elevated to admin role without approval workflow from TOR exit node
args.evidence: U-500 changed role from user to admin at 2024-07-23T03:15:00Z, approved_by: self, IP: 185.220.101.42 (TOR). 12 restricted resources accessed after escalation.
